Final for Publication

NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
3853 North Janssen Avenue
From RT-4 to RM-4.5

The Property
The subject property is located in an RT-4 zoning district, on the east side of North Janssen Avenue. The area
includes RT-4 and RM-5 zoning and is improved with single-family and multi-family residential buildings ranging
in height from one to four stories.

The subject property is a substandard lot of 32.0” feet in width and just over 85.0’ in depth. It is improved with a
three-story residential building with basement (38.0 height) and includes three residential units. There is no
parking as the property’s only right-of-way frontage is on North Janssen Avenue. The property includes a three
story rear addition that is dilapidated and must be replaced.

The Project
Samuel Davison and Clementine Dubourdieu (the “Applicants”) propose to rehabilitate the existing building,

demolish the existing rear addition, and construct a new replacement three-story rear addition. A rear three story
porch also is proposed. The three existing units will remain and an ADU will be added in the basement. The
existing building height will remain the same. No parking exists and none will be provided.

To allow the proposed project, the Applicant also seeks all relief necessary, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, for the proposed project, including: 1) a variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required
rear yard setback per section 17-2-0306-C from 25.61’ to 23°-3” (existing); 2) a variation under section 17-13-
1101-B to reduce the south side setback required per section 17-2-0309 from 3’ 2” to zero (existing); 3) a variation
under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the combined side setback per section 17-2-0309 from 6.4’ to
3°2” (existing); and 4) a variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the front setback from 15° to zero to
allow for a stair leading to the basement to serve the ADU unit.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 2,733 sq. ft.

Floor Area: 4,017 sq. ft.

FAR: 1.47

Residential Dwelling Units: 4 (one of which will be an ADU)
MLA Density: 910.72 sq. ft. (excluding ADU)
Height: 38.0 ft.

Automobile Parking: 0

Rear Yard Open Space: 484 sq. ft.

Setbacks (existing): Front (West): None

Side (North): 3-2”
Side (South): None
Rear (East): 23°-3”

A set of plans is attached.
